title: Finnish Vocabulary - Kirjan Henkilöt
description: A comprehensive vocabulary quiz based on the book characters word list.

questions.question: Both
questions.explanation: 'Molemmat' means both in Finnish.

questions.question: To leave
questions.explanation: 'Lähtee' is the third-person singular form of 'lähteä' (to leave/go).

questions.question: Often
questions.explanation: 'Usein' translates to often or frequently.

questions.question: Why / For what reason
questions.explanation: 'Minkä vuoksi' means why, or for what reason.

questions.question: For a long time
questions.explanation: 'Pitkään' indicates a long duration of time.

questions.question: Until
questions.explanation: 'Kunnes' is used as a conjunction meaning until.

questions.question: Sport / Exercise
questions.explanation: 'Liikunta' refers to physical exercise, sports, or movement.

questions.question: Sector / Field
questions.explanation: '-ala' as a suffix or word means field, sector, or domain.

questions.question: Life
questions.explanation: 'Elämää' is the partitive form of 'elämä' (life).

questions.question: Current / Present
questions.explanation: 'Nykyinen' means current, modern, or present-day.

questions.question: Guests
questions.explanation: 'Vierasta' is the partitive form of 'vieras' (guest/stranger).

questions.question: Everyone / All
questions.explanation: 'Kaikki' stands for all, everything, or everyone.

questions.question: Traditional
questions.explanation: 'Perinteinen' means traditional.

questions.question: In addition / Besides
questions.explanation: 'Lisäksi' is used to say in addition, furthermore, or besides.

questions.question: Certainly / Surely
questions.explanation: 'Varmasti' means certainly, surely, or for sure.

questions.question: Time / Occurrence
questions.explanation: 'Kerta' refers to a single time, instance, or occasion (e.g., yksi kerta = one time).

questions.question: Praise (They praise)
questions.explanation: 'Kehuvat' is the third-person plural form of 'kehua' (to praise).

questions.question: Future
questions.explanation: 'Tulevaisuus' means the future.

questions.question: By the time / By (deadline)
questions.explanation: 'Mennessä' is a postposition used to indicate a deadline.

questions.question: To help
questions.explanation: 'Auttaa' means to help or to assist.

questions.question: Other / Each other (partitive)
questions.explanation: 'Toisia' is the partitive plural of 'toinen' (other).

questions.question: Brave
questions.explanation: 'Rohkea' translates to brave or courageous.

questions.question: Possible
questions.explanation: 'Mahdollista' means possible or feasible.

questions.question: Anymore (used with negative)
questions.explanation: 'Enää' means anymore or longer, typically used in negative sentences.

questions.question: Everywhere
questions.explanation: 'Joka puolella' literally translates to 'on every side', meaning everywhere.

questions.question: Handsome / Great
questions.explanation: 'Komea' means handsome, good-looking, or grand.

questions.question: Better
questions.explanation: 'Parempi' is the comparative form of 'hyvä' (good), meaning better.

questions.question: During / Within
questions.explanation: 'Aikana' is a postposition that means during or in the course of.

questions.question: Finally
questions.explanation: 'Lopuksi' means finally, in conclusion, or at the end.

questions.question: Sky
questions.explanation: 'Taivas' means sky or heaven.

questions.question: Serious
questions.explanation: 'Tosissasi' means seriously or 'in earnest' (addressing 'you').

questions.question: Of course
questions.explanation: 'Tietysti' translates directly to of course or naturally.

questions.question: Because of / Thanks to
questions.explanation: 'Ansiosta' means thanks to or because of something positive.

questions.question: Part / Half
questions.explanation: 'Puoli' means half, side, or part.

questions.question: Trip / Journey
questions.explanation: 'Matka' means trip, journey, or distance.

questions.question: Each other
questions.explanation: 'Toisiaan' is the partitive form of the reciprocal pronoun meaning each other.

questions.question: Next to him/her/them
questions.explanation: 'Viereensä' means next to oneself / him / her / them.

questions.question: A few / Some
questions.explanation: 'Muutama' refers to a few, some, or a couple of items.

questions.question: Important
questions.explanation: 'Tärkeä' translates directly to important.

questions.question: Peace
questions.explanation: 'Rauha' means peace or tranquility.

questions.question: Worried
questions.explanation: 'Huolestunut' means worried, anxious, or concerned.

questions.question: About that / From that
questions.explanation: 'Siitä' is the elatiivi form of 'se', meaning about that or from it.

questions.question: Seas
questions.explanation: 'Meret' is the plural form of 'meri' (sea).

questions.question: Must / Have to
questions.explanation: 'Täytyy' is a modal verb expressing necessity (must / have to).

questions.question: To become polluted
questions.explanation: 'Saastua' means to become polluted or contaminated.

questions.question: Safe / Secure
questions.explanation: 'Turvallinen' translates to safe, secure, or harmless.

questions.question: Still / Yet / More
questions.explanation: 'Vielä' means still, yet, or furthermore depending on context.

questions.question: After / Past
questions.explanation: 'Jälkeen' is a postposition meaning after or past.

questions.question: Room
questions.explanation: 'Huone' means room.

questions.question: In front of
questions.explanation: 'Edessä' is a postposition meaning in front of.

questions.question: Fun
questions.explanation: 'Hauskaa' is the partitive form of 'hauska' (fun/pleasant).
